examples.candidate:
# Completion notifications
## What the product can't do today
Owners cannot see completion without opening each application.
## Who is affected
Company owners monitoring active applications.
## What better looks like
Owners see one completion notification within 60 seconds. Success evidence: compare completion timestamps with delivered in-app notifications in a local fixture.
## Out of scope
Email, SMS, billing and member notifications.
## Constraints
Tenant isolation. No new provider dependency.
## Proposed assumptions
None. Failure/retry behavior is decided in the spec.
